title: Baylor's Hall of Extremes
lede: My twenty-five favourite extreme demons in Geometry Dash. Not a difficulty ranking — a personal one.
description: Baylor's twenty-five favourite Geometry Dash extreme demons of all time, one page each.
aboutHtml:
This is a personal list. It is not a difficulty ranking, and it is not trying to be Pointercrate or AREDL. Every level here earned its place for its own reason — some for how they play, some for how they look, some for what they meant at the time.

Facts on each level page are researched and sourced, and anything that could not be confirmed is shown as an em dash rather than guessed. Every creator, host, verifier, and song artist is credited.
disclaimer: A fan project by Baylor. Unaffiliated with RobTop Games. Levels and songs belong to their creators.
colophon: No cookies, no analytics, no third-party requests. Nothing loads from YouTube until you press play.
